notes.title: A huge update is on the way
notes.notes:
Hey Pilot!

The launch of Xtreme Aces Racing was, above all, the realization of a dream I had since I was 11 years old. It took many months of work and distance from family and friends to get here and I would really like to say a huge thank you to everyone who played the demo, who sent feedback (good or not so good) and to those who also purchased the full version. All of this has meant a lot to me and has been the reason I'm back at the desk, working even harder.

Talking a little about what's to come, some parts of the game are being completely remodeled, mainly to get it back to its arcade essence which was lost between the demo and the full version.

After talking to some players in the community and analyzing comments on the most diverse social platforms, I understood that more speed and more open maps are something very important, so this is the first point to be addressed in development.

Another point to be improved is the booster system. The button + cooldown system will be replaced by a gate format, where the player needs to go through it to gain the extra boost. This increases the challenge even more and gives the player the freedom of choice between the easiest path versus the fastest.

Other improvements and tracks are also being planned, along with the addition of Steam Achievements, but they should arrive in a later version.

Update 1.1 is expected to be released in early March and will come along with a special surprise, which will be announced in the next post.

Cheers and see you soon!

notes.title: Release date confirmed + news
notes.notes:
Hello Xtreme Aces Racing fan!
Once again we want to thank you for the support we have received from the gaming community. Your feedbacks are the compass that guides our development! The last few days before launch have been very intense and we want to share some news with you now:

Story Mode
One of the more requested features we received was to bring a story mode to Xtreme Aces Racing. As such, we've developed a simple yet intense story mode where you'll start as a rookie pilot and must progress to being the champion of the Xtreme Aces main category. With each stage won, a bit of history will unfold and you will also receive an award that you can use to buy better (and faster) jets to progress on your career. Another important detail is that with each new stage, the difficulty level of the AI ​​and the tracks will also increase, so you'll need more skill and better jets if you want to reach the top.

Local Multiplayer
We've also developed a split-screen two-player mode where you can play a single race or championship with a friend, and I can say we had a lot of fun testing it! :)

New Locations and Track Conditions
In addition to the desert and forest environments available in the demo, we've also added snow and night racing in the full version, which adds more excitement and possibilities of different scenarios you'll need to overcome during the races.

Other Improvements
Last but not least, we're also making some visual improvements in the game, some on the jets, and some in the tracks adding more elements and indicators, so you know exactly where to go.

 Release Date Confirmed
Xtreme Aces Racing is coming on the next January 13th. If you haven't added the game to Wishlist yet, do so now and get notified as soon as the game is released!

notes.title: Demo Version Update
notes.notes:
First of all, many thanks to the thousands of players who supported us and who are helping us shape the future of Xtreme Aces Racing!

We've watched community reviews on Youtube and we've also analyzed each of the feedbacks received, and we're happy to announce our first fully community-driven update to the demo version.

Controls Improvements

The first new thing is related to the game controls. Yes! Seeing the game being played by a wide variety of controls and sticks, we realized that not everyone was happy with the gameplay and keymap that came by default in the game. That's why we've added an option for you to define how you want to play Xtreme Aces Racing!

https://i.imgur.com/Vf2UVWa.jpeg

Additionally, after seeing a lot of people hitting the ground in the first few seconds of the game, we added the option to invert the jet's pitch axis, so those players who are not familiar to flight simulator games can now use the up arrow to go up and the down arrow to descend.

Random Powerup Boxes

Lastly, a long-awaited new feature was also introduced in this update. Random powerups! By hitting a box with a question mark you can receive any of the items available in the game completely randomly. This increases the excitement and makes the results even more unpredictable.

https://i.imgur.com/wntOrf9.jpeg

Did you like the updates? Tell us!
